description: This file defines a static utility enum 'ModelCatalogLoader' responsible for locating, loading, parsing, and caching a JavaScript-based model catalog in a Swift project. It includes methods to resolve file paths, sanitize JavaScript source, evaluate JavaScript code within a JSContext, and produce a sorted list of 'ModelChoice' objects. The code interacts with the filesystem, bundle resources, and JavaScript context for dynamic parsing.

methods.name: defaultPath
methods.description: Returns the default file path for the model catalog, resolving cache, bundle, or node_modules paths.

methods.name: load(from:)
methods.description: Asynchronously loads and parses the model catalog from a specified path, returning a sorted array of ModelChoice instances.
